rule: random.Random(seed) over the sorted ids; 4 traps and 26 answerable items. Per group: the number per query language is the language's share of the group (largest remainder, ties in language order); the number of dev items is the dev share of the group (largest remainder), spread over the languages by their dev counts, the rest comes from test; inside each (language, split) the items are drawn uniformly from the sorted ids
